name: reverb-mcp
description: Reverb (ecommerce channels): me, update_listing, set_inventory, end_listing, list_orders, mark_shipp

platform_mcp_reverb_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_REVERB_TOKEN
platform_mcp_reverb_token.description: Reverb Personal Access Token (My Profile > API & Integrations > Generate New Token) with scopes public, read_listings, write_listings, read_orders, write_orders; personal tokens do not expire. Sent as Authorization: Bearer.

platform_mcp_reverb_currency.title: PLATFORM_MCP_REVERB_CURRENCY
platform_mcp_reverb_currency.description: Currency of your listing prices, e.g. USD; required when update_listing sends a price.

tools.name: update_listing
tools.description: PUT /api/listings/{listing_id} with the create parameters you want to change (title, description, price {amount, currency}, inventory). Live listings change immediately. `listing_id` is the Reverb listing id (find it by SKU with GET /api/my/listings?sku=…&state=all).

tools.name: set_inventory
tools.description: PUT /api/listings/{listing_id} {has_inventory: true, inventory} sets the stock of a listing that tracks inventory; `listing_id` is required (Reverb listings are addressed by id). With inventory 0 a listing shows as a draft until stock is added.

tools.name: end_listing
tools.description: PUT /api/my/listings/{id}/state/end {reason: not_sold} transitions a live listing to ended (the reverb_sale reason, which bills a selling fee for an in-person sale, is not used).

tools.name: list_orders
tools.description: GET /api/my/orders/selling/{all|unpaid|awaiting_shipment}: `status` selects that list (default all); since = updated_start_date (ISO-8601). Rows carry order_number, status (unpaid|payment_pending|pending_review|blocked|paid|shipped|picked_up|received|refunded|cancelled), total {amount, currency}; addresses and links in raw. `page` follows Reverb's page numbering.

tools.name: mark_shipped
tools.description: POST /api/my/orders/selling/{order_number}/ship {provider, tracking_number, send_notification: true} marks the order shipped and e-mails the buyer. `carrier` must be a provider from GET /api/shipping/providers (e.g. USPS, UPS, FedEx, DHL).
